summary_markdown:
The conversation covered two main topics: first, a technical issue with the recalculation (recalc) process where Step 19 (`clear_sessions.sql`) was missed during testing, leading to data being cleared for March 1st. It was confirmed that only the model and aggregation needed reprocessing, not a full rerun.

Second, a discrepancy in analytics data was discussed regarding unique traffic counts across time periods (night vs. day). A user questioned why night-only unique traffic appeared when total traffic did not, suggesting potential double-counting of sessions spanning midnight. It was determined that the issue was a bug, and the speaker found the cause. The fix would be implemented in the evening.
decisions: The recalculation process only required reprocessing the model and aggregation layers for March 1st data.
A bug causing incorrect unique traffic counts across midnight boundaries will be fixed by the end of the day.
action_items: Implement the fix for the analytics bug in the evening.
Update Jira ticket DOOH-84 with the resolution.
